payload.friendly_name: Charter CLI typed errors and JSON
payload.purpose_context: Operators and tooling get an actionable, coded refusal when charter.yaml is broken instead of an 'Unexpected error', and can read activation changes and the effective activation state as documented JSON without parsing files or human text. Covers #6557 and the independent local-acceptance slices of #6525 and #6526; contract integration stays with epic #6518.
payload.purpose_tldr: Charter status, activate and deactivate report failures with a typed code and offer machine-readable JSON output.

options: Canonical for new, add code to status
payload.question: Which JSON error envelope should charter status/activate/deactivate use?

payload.final_answer: Canonical everywhere: status, activate and deactivate errors all use {ok:false,error:{code,message}} (json_contract.json_error); status's legacy error envelope is replaced (breaking for status error consumers; CHANGELOG note).

payload.question: Should new JSON payloads carry a schema version?

payload.final_answer: Local schema_version 1.0.0 on the activate/deactivate success payload and inside the status activation block; labelled local, not the contract revision (#6521 held).

payload.question: Field naming of the status activation block?

payload.final_answer: snake_case, local: source, path, selected, deactivated, mission_types, activated_kinds, required; camelCase contract mapping left to #6520.

options: Credit only if they share work
payload.question: How to credit volunteer Venkatasai200628 on #6557?

payload.final_answer: Credit only if they share work: Co-authored-by trailer if they link a branch/draft before the PR; otherwise thank and invite review.

payload.question: Local error codes for activate/deactivate/status refusals?

payload.final_answer: Confirm: intent summary as presented (status typed refusal; activate/deactivate --json with versioned success payload and cascade report; status activation block; text byte-identical except refusal/coded error lines; no contract values invented).

Proposed local set: ACTIVATION_KIND_UNKNOWN, CASCADE_SCOPE_INVALID, DEACTIVATION_REFUSED_REQUIRED, CHARTER_WRITE_ROOT_INVALID, ACTIVATION_FAILED, CHARTER_CONFIG_SHAPE_INVALID, CHARTER_STATUS_FAILED, INTERNAL_ERROR, plus existing ACTIVE_CHARTER_CONFIG_INVALID; text prints Error (<CODE>): ...

Confirm: CLI-layer report module; tidy-first WP01 with golden text; captured console under --json; activation read via charter.activation.api; render_coded_error everywhere + enumeration ADOPTED; WP01-WP04 slicing.
